= Structurizr Block

A type this image recognises but cannot render. The jar ships with asciidoctor-diagram,
but the converter wants DIAGRAM_STRUCTURIZR_CLASSPATH pointed at it, so `--format
rendered` fails here and says so.

Extracting the source still works, and that is the whole reason the two lists are
separate: pulling text out of a block needs no renderer, and handing a diagram to a
reader or a model is what this tool is for.

[structurizr]
----
workspace {
  model {
    user = person "Reader"
  }
  views {
  }
}
----
